sentences.zh: 我们还探讨了她给有志于从事心理学工作的人的顶级建议，以及如何在应对身体健康诊断的同时处理工作及其带来的一切影响。

sentences.en: Hi, just want to welcome our guest for today, Dr. Liz Gregory.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我想欢迎我们今天的嘉宾，Liz Gregory 博士。

sentences.en: Hi,
sentences.zh: 嗨，

sentences.en: Liz.
sentences.zh: Liz。

sentences.en: Hi, really nice to be here.
sentences.zh: 嗨，很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: Thank you for the invitation.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你的邀请。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you for saying yes.
sentences.zh: 哦，谢谢你答应参加。

sentences.en: So you caught my eye on Twitter because you were celebrating your retirement from being a consultant clinical psychologist, weren't you?
sentences.zh: 你在 Twitter 上引起了我的注意，因为你当时正在庆祝你从临床心理学顾问的岗位上退休，对吧？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah, I retired last week after 32 years in the NHS and 27 years in one health board and 21 years as joint head of child and family psychology services there in
sentences.zh: 是的，我在 NHS 工作了 32 年，在一个卫生委员会工作了 27 年，并在那里的格温特担任儿童与家庭心理服务联合主管 21 年后，于上周退休了。

sentences.en: Gwent.
sentences.zh: 格温特。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Well done to you.
sentences.zh: 做得好。

sentences.en: And I'm sure that so many people, both clients and staff alike have benefited so richly from that real, real dedication to your work.
sentences.zh: 我相信很多人，无论是客户还是员工，都从你对工作的真正奉献中受益匪浅。

sentences.en: So thank you on their behalf.
sentences.zh: 所以我代表他们向你表示感谢。

sentences.en: I'm sure they've also said thank you to you in your retirement cards and things as well.
sentences.zh: 我相信他们在你的退休贺卡和礼物中也表达了谢意。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was a really lovely event and it was a particularly poignant event because I've spent the last seven months actually being treated for breast cancer.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是一个非常可爱的活动，而且特别令人心酸，因为我过去七个月实际上一直在接受乳腺癌治疗。

sentences.en: So to return and retire and to have all of that acknowledgement, having to really put some distance between myself and work in order just to get on
sentences.zh: 所以能回来退休并得到所有这些认可，而在那之前我不得不真正地与工作保持距离，以便专注于

sentences.en: with the job in hand, which was obviously putting my health first, made it particularly, yeah, poignant, I would say, and very different to how I'd anticipated it.
sentences.zh: 手头的工作，也就是显然要把健康放在第一位，这让我觉得特别心酸，也和我预想的非常不同。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: I hope that you are in better health now.
sentences.zh: 希望你现在身体健康状况好转了。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对好转了。

sentences.en: I've come to the end of my treatment and I've rung the bell, which is the kind of punctuation of treatment in cancer services.
sentences.zh: 我已经结束了治疗，并敲响了钟，这是癌症服务中治疗结束的一种标志。

sentences.en: It's always a tricky one because I think once you've had cancer, you never actually fully believe that you're over it.
sentences.zh: 这总是很棘手，因为我觉得一旦你得过癌症，你就永远不会真正完全相信自己已经彻底康复了。

sentences.en: And I've got my first milestone scan in AuguSt. So I'm obviously, you know, anticipating that.
sentences.zh: 我八月份要进行第一次里程碑式的扫描。所以显然，你知道，我很期待那个结果。

sentences.en: But as far as the treatment has gone, it's gone as well as it could.
sentences.zh: 但就治疗而言，进行得尽可能顺利。

sentences.en: So I'm keeping everything crossed.
sentences.zh: 所以我祈祷一切顺利。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: I'm so pleased for you.
sentences.zh: 我真为你高兴。

sentences.en: And even when I hear you and others say, you know, I've rung the bell, gosh, it really gets my feels, you know, it's massive, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 即使当我听到你和其他人说，你知道，“我敲响了钟”，天哪，这真的触动了我的心弦，你知道，这意义重大，不是吗？

sentences.en: It's so significant.
sentences.zh: 这太重要了。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It's a really tricky one.
sentences.zh: 这真的很棘手。

sentences.en: And I, you know, I was a bit ambivalent about it, if I'm honest, for lots and lots of reasons.
sentences.zh: 说实话，出于很多很多原因，我当时对这件事有点矛盾。

sentences.en: I think firstly, because as I say, you never quite feel it's over.
sentences.zh: 我想首先是因为正如我所说，你永远不会觉得它真的结束了。

sentences.en: Secondly, I never quite know how it feels for the other people in the waiting area who may, you know, be a long way from that or may actually not be able to do that.
sentences.zh: 其次，我永远不知道候诊区里的其他人会有什么感觉，他们可能离那个阶段还很远，或者可能根本无法做到这一点。

sentences.en: So that's always a bit difficult.
sentences.zh: 所以这总是有点困难。

sentences.en: But it also felt like an important thing to do for my family who've been supporting me
sentences.zh: 但对于一直支持我的家人来说，这似乎也是一件重要的事情，

sentences.en: and just to, you know, as I say, it's a punctuation and it marks a change of phase is how I see it, rather than a woohoo, it's all over.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，这是一种标点，我把它看作是一个阶段的改变，而不是一种“哇，一切都结束了”的欢呼。

sentences.en: I, you know, I don't quite see it like that.
sentences.zh: 我，你知道，我不完全是那样看的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So it might be that it feels more of a rite of passage for your family, but I love that you're so mindful of what others around you, you know, might make of that.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能对你的家人来说更像是一种成人礼，但我很喜欢你如此体贴周围的人对这件事的看法。

sentences.en: Well, once a psychologiSt. Yeah, but I have worked really hard, actually, at trying to put myself first through this journey.
sentences.zh: 嗯，毕竟曾经是心理学家。是的，但我确实非常努力地尝试在这段旅程中把自己放在第一位。

sentences.en: And, you know, obviously, finishing work in order to concentrate on treatment was was big for me, because I've not had a period of sickness, as far as I can remember at all.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，显然，为了专注于治疗而结束工作对我来说是一个重大决定，因为据我所记得，我从未有过病假。

sentences.en: So it was quite a big step, but a really, really important one.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个很大的步骤，但确实非常非常重要。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I guess there's still knowing that we're allowed to be mindful and really pleased
sentences.zh: 我想我们仍然知道我们被允许保持正念，并为我们自己的健康

sentences.en: that our own health has has, you know, had a great outcome, whilst also being moved by the distress of others, you know, it's that mutual exclusivity, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 取得了很好的结果而感到真正高兴，同时也被他人的痛苦所感动，你知道，这就是那种互斥性，不是吗？

sentences.en: You know, you're allowed to have one and the other.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你被允许同时拥有这两种感受。

sentences.en: Absolutely, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对，绝对。

sentences.en: And cancer has been a real challenge for that one, I think.
sentences.zh: 我认为癌症在这方面确实是一个真正的挑战。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So tell me a little bit, if you can, about your experience of being treated by the NHS, rather than working within it.
sentences.zh: 那么，如果可以的话，请告诉我一些你作为患者在 NHS 接受治疗，而不是在其中工作的经历。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, it's, it's been phenomenal, I have to say.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，这真是太棒了，我必须得说。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, I have had a bit of private treatment along the way as well, because my husband happens to have private care.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，你知道，我在此过程中也接受了一些私人治疗，因为我丈夫正好有私人医疗保险。

sentences.en: But it is, it's quite interchangeable when it comes to cancer.
sentences.zh: 但在癌症治疗方面，两者是可以互换的。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, every interaction I've had with every member of staff has been just incredible.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，你知道，我与每一位工作人员的每一次互动都令人难以置信。

sentences.en: And I, that's not always the case.
sentences.zh: 而且，情况并非总是如此。

sentences.en: I know that I'm fully aware of that.
sentences.zh: 我知道，我完全意识到这一点。

sentences.en: But I can genuinely say that from my personal experience.
sentences.zh: 但我可以真诚地说，这是我个人的经历。

sentences.en: And I guess
sentences.zh: 我想

sentences.en: I'm very grateful for that at a time when I needed it moSt. And just the competence and the kindness and
sentences.zh: 我在最需要的时候对此非常感激。而且仅仅是那种能力、善良和

sentences.en: the, I think the reassurance that you're in this system, and we know what we're doing, and you're going to go through this, this, this and this.
sentences.zh: 我想，那种让你感到安心的感觉，即“你在这个系统中，我们知道我们在做什么，你将经历这个、这个、这个和这个”。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's just been terribly straightforward.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这真的非常直接。

sentences.en: It's been grueling.
sentences.zh: 这很折磨人。

sentences.en: I'm not going to underestimate that at all.
sentences.zh: 我一点也不会低估这一点。

sentences.en: And I've had some really tricky experiences.
sentences.zh: 而且我确实有一些非常棘手的经历。

sentences.en: So when I had my first chemotherapy, I had a neutropinic sepsis response.
sentences.zh: 所以当我进行第一次化疗时，我出现了中性粒细胞减少性败血症反应。

sentences.en: So had to be admitted very urgently.
sentences.zh: 所以必须非常紧急地入院。

sentences.en: But again, all part of what they see, all part of what they can anticipate, and all part of what they're geared up to address.
sentences.zh: 但同样，这都在他们的预料之中，都是他们可以预见的一部分，也是他们准备好应对的一部分。

sentences.en: So it really has been pretty spectacular, I have to say.
sentences.zh: 所以我必须说，这确实非常壮观。

sentences.en: I'm delighted that you found that to be the case.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴你发现情况确实如此。

sentences.en: I really am.
sentences.zh: 我真的很高兴。

sentences.en: And that you've, you know, got good stuff to say.
sentences.zh: 而且你，你知道，有好的事情要说。

sentences.en: And, you know, you've had a good experience and a great outcome.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你有过很好的经历和很好的结果。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对。

sentences.en: Can we think a little bit about your career and how that's been for you?
sentences.zh: 我们可以谈谈你的职业生涯以及这对你来说是怎样的吗？

sentences.en: So when did you, when did you start deciding that you might want to be a clinical psychologist?
sentences.zh: 那么你是什么时候开始决定想成为一名临床心理学家的？

sentences.en: It's a very long time ago, I have to say.
sentences.zh: 那是很久以前的事了，我必须得说。

sentences.en: So I did my undergraduate degree, and that was a four year degree in psychology in Cardiff.
sentences.zh: 我读了本科，那是卡迪夫大学心理学四年制学位。

sentences.en: And I chose psychology, I would say, because I didn't know what else to do.
sentences.zh: 我选择心理学，我想是因为我不知道还能做什么。

sentences.en: And I was okay, at the sciences, and I was okay at the arts.
sentences.zh: 我的理科还可以，文科也还可以。

sentences.en: So it was, it kind of felt like a good combination type degree.
sentences.zh: 所以这感觉像是一个很好的综合类学位。

sentences.en: And I kind of went into it, and chose a degree with a year in industry or a year, a placement opportunity, really to help me think about what on earth I was going to do.
sentences.zh: 我进入了这个领域，选择了一个有行业实习年或实习机会的学位，真的是为了帮助我思考我到底要做什么。

sentences.en: And I did my year in industry in HR, and it really served a great purpose, because it was, you know, a fantastic experience, but I knew it wasn't for me.
sentences.zh: 我在人力资源部门度过了我的行业实习年，它确实起到了很大的作用，因为，你知道，这是一次很棒的经历，但我知道它不适合我。

sentences.en: But I was also, I think I was the first in my family to go to university, didn't see myself as particularly academic at all.
sentences.zh: 但我也是，我想我是家里第一个上大学的人，根本没觉得自己特别有学术天赋。

sentences.en: And so really wrote myself off the clinical path, which even then was, you know, pretty tough in terms of
sentences.zh: 所以真的把自己排除在临床道路之外了，即使在当时，你知道，在竞争方面也非常艰难，

sentences.en: competitiveness, and, and who puts themselves through that.
sentences.zh: 而且，谁会让自己经历那种过程呢。

sentences.en: So I felt that wasn't for me, but I honestly didn't know what else I was going to do.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得那不适合我，但我真的不知道我还能做什么。

sentences.en: And other than it wasn't going to be HR.
sentences.zh: 除了肯定不是人力资源。

sentences.en: And no disrespect to that at all, but it just wasn't a good fit for me.
sentences.zh: 对那个行业没有任何不敬，但它确实不适合我。

sentences.en: And so I worked for a housing association for adults with learning disabilities.
sentences.zh: 所以我为一家为学习障碍成人服务的住房协会工作。

sentences.en: And I think that really introduced me into the world of, obviously, vulnerable groups, but also empowerment and positive choice and change.
sentences.zh: 我认为这确实让我进入了弱势群体的世界，但也让我接触到了赋权、积极选择和改变。

sentences.en: And that was very much at the time when the hospitals were closing down and adults were going out into the community.
sentences.zh: 那正是医院关闭、成年人进入社区的时期。

sentences.en: And I just absolutely loved it.
sentences.zh: 我真的非常喜欢它。

sentences.en: And then I applied for a job as a data input clerk at a hospital at the time, and it was doing research into interventions for people with learning disabilities.
sentences.zh: 然后我申请了一份医院数据录入员的工作，当时正在研究针对学习障碍人士的干预措施。

sentences.en: And I think I wouldn't dare apply for an assistant psychology post at that time, because again, I didn't see myself as being able and capable of doing that and pursuing that.
sentences.zh: 我想当时我不敢申请心理学助理职位，因为同样，我不认为自己有能力和资格去做那件事并追求它。

sentences.en: But the, I didn't get the job.
sentences.zh: 但是，我没得到那份工作。

sentences.en: But the person on the interview panel said there is another job, and I think you'd be really great for that.
sentences.zh: 但面试小组的人说还有另一份工作，我觉得你非常适合那份工作。

sentences.en: So, you know, just, I needed that confidence building
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我只是需要那种建立自信的

sentences.en: incentive, I think, to take that step.
sentences.zh: 激励，我想，才能迈出那一步。

sentences.en: And so I got a job as a psychology assistant, absolutely loved it.
sentences.zh: 所以我得到了一份心理学助理的工作，非常喜欢它。

sentences.en: I mean, I, you know, I shudder now at the level of responsibility assistants were given in those
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，我现在想到那时候助理被赋予的责任水平都会不寒而栗，

sentences.en: days, and particularly in learning disability services, because I think that recruitment was really, really tough.
sentences.zh: 特别是在学习障碍服务中，因为我认为那时的招聘真的非常非常困难。

sentences.en: And so they would fill a gap for a qualified person with an assistant and kind of you'd be off on your own in a team and so called doing the job.
sentences.zh: 所以他们会用助理来填补合格人员的空缺，你基本上就是一个人在一个团队里，所谓的在做这份工作。

sentences.en: But I learned a huge amount in that job and had, you know, great fun and great support.
sentences.zh: 但我在那份工作中获益良多，而且，你知道，玩得很开心，也得到了很好的支持。

sentences.en: And it gave me the confidence to apply for clinical training.
sentences.zh: 这给了我申请临床培训的信心。

sentences.en: So I applied.
sentences.zh: 所以我申请了。

sentences.en: And I remember, I also, you know, assumed I wouldn't get on.
sentences.zh: 我记得，我也，你知道，假设我不会被录取。

sentences.en: And I had a car that I was going to sell and travel, you know, do the kind of year round traveling around the world.
sentences.zh: 我有一辆车，我打算卖掉它去旅行，你知道，进行那种环游世界的年度旅行。

sentences.en: So I felt I put myself into that position where I had a great alternative, you know, I wasn't going to be too disappointed.
sentences.zh: 所以我感觉我把自己置于一个有很好替代选择的位置，你知道，我不会太失望。

sentences.en: And I got on.
sentences.zh: 结果我被录取了。

sentences.en: And that was the story.
sentences.zh: 这就是故事。

sentences.en: And it was the Plymouth course that I did my clinical training and
sentences.zh: 我是在普利茅斯课程完成的临床培训，

sentences.en: amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And that all went relatively smoothly, I hope.
sentences.zh: 希望这一切都进行得相对顺利。

sentences.en: Yeah, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的。

sentences.zh: 但我认为其中有一种严谨性，我确实从中受益匪浅。

sentences.zh: 我记得除了实习，我们还得做案例研究和调研，还要写大量的论文。

sentences.en: So one big essay per placement, but also 10 short essays per placement.
sentences.zh: 每次实习要写一篇大论文，还要写10篇短论文。

sentences.en: And I think that gave me a real skill in extracting important information and putting it down and not worrying too much about it, which I think has
sentences.zh: 我认为这让我掌握了一种真正的技能，即提取重要信息并将其记录下来，而不用为此过度担忧，我觉得这

sentences.en: And I think that that was really, really

sentences.zh: 完成了。

sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这也能让你对核心能力、

sentences.zh: 我知道我也是这么觉得的。

sentences.en: Yeah, my, my first role was, um, for children, um, with, um, intellectual disabilities, learning disabilities,
sentences.zh: 是的，我的第一份工作是为患有智力障碍、学习障碍的儿童服务，

sentences.en: and particularly, um, an intensive support service for, um, children who, um, whose behaviors were challenging to services.
sentences.zh: 特别是为那些行为对服务机构构成挑战的儿童提供强化支持服务。

sentences.en: Um, and yeah, that was very intensive.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那确实非常紧张。

sentences.en: And I did that for a year and then I moved to the
sentences.zh: 我做了那份工作一年，然后就转到了

sentences.en: Health Board where I, I've spent the rest of my career.
sentences.zh: 卫生委员会，我在那里度过了职业生涯的其余时间。

sentences.en: So what have you been doing in Health Board?
sentences.zh: 那么你在卫生委员会都做了些什么？

sentences.en: What's your role been?
sentences.zh: 你的角色是什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, well, I, I, I started as a, what we call a borough psychologiSt. So there were, um, five boroughs in our region and each region had one psychologiSt. So we were very sparse
sentences.zh: 嗯，我最初是所谓的“区心理学家”。我们地区有五个区，每个区有一名心理学家。所以我们的人手非常稀缺，

sentences.en: and it was one of those, you know, again, I think recruitment and resources were a huge factor in this,
sentences.zh: 这也是其中之一，你知道，同样地，我认为招聘和资源在其中是一个巨大的因素，

sentences.en: but, um, you could start as a borough psychologist at a very junior level, but it was actually a very senior role.
sentences.zh: 但是，你可以在非常初级的水平上开始担任区心理学家，但实际上这是一个非常高级的角色。

sentences.en: So I guess that preceptorship and, um, being supported in the job and developing in the
sentences.zh: 所以我猜那种入职培训，以及在工作中得到支持并在工作中发展，

sentences.en: job was something that was absolutely part and parcel of, of, um, you know, what, what the careers were at that time.
sentences.zh: 绝对是当时职业生涯中不可或缺的一部分。

sentences.en: Um, and I absolutely loved it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我非常喜欢它。

sentences.en: It was, it was a great service.
sentences.zh: 那是一项很棒的服务。

sentences.en: It had fantastic values.
sentences.zh: 它有着极好的价值观。

sentences.en: Um, and I loved the community that, um, you know, was my borough and it was a big sense of
sentences.zh: 嗯，我热爱那个社区，你知道，那是我的辖区，而且有一种强烈的

sentences.en: responsibility as well in that, um, you know, whatever came through the door, you, you were the psychologist who was going to be dealing with it.
sentences.zh: 责任感，因为，你知道，无论什么样的情况找上门来，你都是那个要处理它的心理学家。

sentences.en: So that, that, that felt huge at the time, but I think a really good, um, experience of kind of learning that that's okay.
sentences.zh: 所以当时感觉压力很大，但我认为这是一种非常好的、学习到“没关系”的经验。

sentences.en: We've got the skills, we can apply them to whatever the, the dilemmas are, uh, and kind of taking a breath and not feeling you've got to fix everything.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有技能，我们可以将它们应用于任何困境，深呼吸，不要觉得你必须解决所有问题。

sentences.en: Um, but the, the, the skills you bring are about curiosity and understanding and taking time and being alongside.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但你带来的技能是关于好奇心、理解力、花时间陪伴以及与他人并肩作战。

sentences.en: Um, so it was a fantastic training, um, in, in, in, I suppose, that aspect of the job, as well as the huge variety, um, of, of, uh, issues that
sentences.zh: 所以这是一次很棒的训练，嗯，在工作的那个方面，以及家庭在任何时候可能提出的各种各样的问题。

sentences.en: families might present with at any one time.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I think that's going to be really useful advice for anybody listening to this as well, because the nature of this beast that we work
sentences.zh: 我认为这对任何听众来说都是非常有用的建议，因为我们所从事的这个行业的本质就是，

sentences.en: in is that you're going to have many placements or many roles and you've got to be able to sort of just run with it.
sentences.zh: 你会有很多实习或很多角色，你必须能够顺其自然。

sentences.en: And I know when I first qualified, I thought I was, um, going to be sort of getting kid gloves and they would be quite leisurely start, but no, they'd be waiting for me for months.
sentences.zh: 我知道我刚获得资格时，以为我会得到优待，会有一个相当悠闲的开始，但并没有，他们已经等了我好几个月了。

sentences.en: So they were keen for me to run with it.
sentences.zh: 所以他们很渴望我能立刻上手。

sentences.en: And they said, you are in a, in the nicest possible way.
sentences.zh: 他们说，以最友好的方式说，

sentences.en: They were really nice about it, but you're qualified.
sentences.zh: 他们对此真的很友善，但你已经获得资格了。

sentences.en: We trust you to do this.
sentences.zh: 我们相信你能做到这一点。

sentences.en: You know, to go out there and do the job.
sentences.zh: 你知道，去外面把工作做好。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And I think that's such an important aspect of our training that we, we need the confidence to, to be reassured.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是我们培训中非常重要的一点，我们需要信心来获得保证。

sentences.en: We've been doing this for a very, very long time.
sentences.zh: 我们已经从事这个行业很长很长时间了。

sentences.en: And what we're bringing is those skills, not a magic wand, not the answer and not the years of experience on the job that other people in the team have.
sentences.zh: 我们带来的是那些技能，而不是魔杖，不是现成的答案，也不是团队中其他人所拥有的多年工作经验。

sentences.en: Um, so trusting that it is about that difference that we bring and that that's valued and valuable is, is a really important part of the job.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以相信我们带来的这种差异是有价值的，这是工作中非常重要的一部分。

sentences.en: I think.
sentences.zh: 我是这么认为的。

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我也这么认为。

sentences.en: But I found that really empowering actually, that they weren't saying, well, you're not quite finished yet.
sentences.zh: 但我发现这真的很令人振奋，他们并没有说“你还没完全准备好”。

sentences.en: You know, um, they were saying, you know, go out there, do it, smash it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们是在说，去吧，去做吧，大干一场。

sentences.en: And if there's any problems, just bring them back here and we'll talk about it in supervision.
sentences.zh: 如果有任何问题，带回来，我们在督导中讨论。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: So you must've seen your fair share of aspiring psychologists, assistant psychologists, trainee psychologists, newly qualified psychologists across your career.
sentences.zh: 所以你在职业生涯中一定见过不少有抱负的心理学家、助理心理学家、实习心理学家和刚获得资格的心理学家。

sentences.en: Um, how's that been for you watching the profession change over time?
sentences.zh: 嗯，看着这个行业随着时间的推移而改变，你感觉如何？

sentences.en: Yeah, it's been fabulous.
sentences.zh: 是的，这太棒了。

sentences.en: I think it's been one of the most exciting parts of the job is that, um, you know, seeing the journey that people are on and we've often had people who've come as placement
sentences.zh: 我认为这是工作中令人兴奋的部分之一，嗯，你知道，看到人们所经历的旅程，我们经常有以实习生身份来的人，

sentences.en: students, then come back as assistants, then come back as qualified staff.
sentences.zh: 然后回来做助理，再回来做合格的员工。

sentences.en: So I just love that full circle.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的很喜欢这种圆满的循环。

sentences.en: And also that message to us as a service that we were getting it right enough that they wanted to come back and that, um, you know, that we supported them on that journey.
sentences.zh: 这也向我们传达了一个信息，作为服务机构，我们做得足够好，以至于他们想回来，而且，你知道，我们在那段旅程中支持了他们。

sentences.en: So I've, I've really, really enjoyed that.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的很、真的很享受这一点。

sentences.en: Um, I think the changes it's, it's really tough because when you're in it, you don't kind of notice the, the stepwise changes.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这些变化，真的很艰难，因为当你身处其中时，你不会注意到那些逐步的变化。

sentences.en: And I think one of the things that we've been passionate about, uh, in our service is that the core values remain.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们服务机构一直热衷的一件事就是核心价值观保持不变。

sentences.en: So the things that I was saying
sentences.zh: 所以我在20年前说的那些对儿童和家庭很重要的事情，

sentences.en: 20 years ago that are important for children and families are still important for children and families.
sentences.zh: 现在对儿童和家庭来说依然很重要。

sentences.en: But, um, you know, I hope that we're a very broad church, uh, in our service and that
sentences.zh: 但是，嗯，你知道，我希望我们的服务是一个非常包容的大家庭，

sentences.en: psychology is a very broad church and that we're continuously learning, um, and that curiosity and
sentences.zh: 心理学是一个非常广泛的领域，我们一直在学习，嗯，那种好奇心，

sentences.en: not thinking we've got the answer, um, but that we keep learning and we keep open, being open to new ideas, new ways of working, new ways of thinking.
sentences.zh: 不要认为我们已经有了答案，而是我们保持学习，保持开放，接受新想法、新工作方式、新思维方式。

sentences.en: It's just part and parcel of, I think, what we've tried to, um, promote in our service.
sentences.zh: 这只是我们试图在服务中推广的内容的一部分。

sentences.en: And I think it's, I think it's absolutely vital.
sentences.zh: 我认为这绝对至关重要。

sentences.en: Um, yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是啊。

sentences.en: And I feel passionately about that and I feel really, um, proud of our profession for that, that it's, there's not
sentences.zh: 我对此充满热情，我真的为我们的职业感到自豪，因为没有一个终点，

sentences.en: an end point where we're, and, and, and not to feel bad about what you didn't know before, that that's all part of the process.
sentences.zh: 不要因为以前不知道的事情而感到难过，那都是过程的一部分。

sentences.en: And our job is to bring the knowledge base that we have now to the difficulties that people are experiencing and see how that fits, but to never think this is the answer
sentences.zh: 我们的工作是将我们现在拥有的知识基础带给人们所经历的困难，看看它如何适用，但永远不要认为这就是答案，

sentences.en: and you need to do this in order to solve your problem.
sentences.zh: 你需要这样做才能解决你的问题。

sentences.en: So it, you know, it fits quite well with the evolving nature of the profession, I think.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我认为这与行业不断发展的本质非常契合。

sentences.en: Hmm.

sentences.zh: 尽我所能利用当时拥有的技能和资源去做。

sentences.zh: 只是，我知道我现在会做得好得多。

sentences.en: Well, of course, and wouldn't we all, and, you know, and I think in child psychology and as a parent, you know, that's the, that's exactly the feeling.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当然，我们不都会这样吗？而且，你知道，我认为在儿童心理学和作为父母方面，你知道，这正是那种感觉。

sentences.en: It's like, if I knew them what I know now, but I didn't, and I did everything with the absolute best intention.
sentences.zh: 就像是，如果我当时知道我现在所知道的就好了，但我不知道，我所做的一切都是出于最好的意图。

sentences.en: Uh, and also, you know, I talk about the values that endure, the most powerful value I think is the power of the relationship.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且，你知道，我谈到了持久的价值观，我认为最强大的价值观是关系的力量。

sentences.en: Uh, and if you're working hard at creating relationships, it doesn't matter where you are, uh, on your career trajectory,

sentences.zh: 我有两个小男孩。

sentences.zh: 但也要鼓励他们修复裂痕，而不是掩盖它们。

sentences.zh: 因为我认为这真的、真的非常重要。

sentences.en: And we can absolutely learn to do that with clients as well.
sentences.zh: 我们绝对可以学会与客户也这样做。

sentences.en: Can't we to repair any ruptures in our relationship?
sentences.zh: 不是吗？修复我们关系中的任何裂痕？

sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And, you know, and obviously our, our, um, relationships with professions, with teams, with, with other services,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，显然我们与专业人士、团队、其他服务的关系，

sentences.en: it's exactly the same as that, that we're on a journey together and we're open to learning.

sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Um, I mean, I think our job as psychologists is to really promote, promote that relational, developmental, contextual understanding of children's distress.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，我认为我们作为心理学家的工作是真正促进对儿童痛苦的关系性、发展性、背景性的理解。

sentences.en: Uh, and, you know, to kind of, um, see that as our role, regardless of the presenting problem, those things are, are, are absolutely critical to our understanding.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且，你知道，要将此视为我们的角色，无论出现什么问题，这些事情对我们的理解都绝对是至关重要的。

sentences.en: Uh, and obviously, um, from a, uh, rights-based approach, children's rights, the importance of hearing their voice, empowerment,
sentences.zh: 嗯，显然，从基于权利的方法来看，儿童权利、倾听他们的声音、赋权的重要性，

sentences.en: but also I think the, um, importance of their context, the family, uh, the system around them,
sentences.zh: 但我也认为他们的背景、家庭、他们周围系统的重要性，

sentences.en: and the vehicles for change that they have in their wider system is absolutely pivotal to our work.
sentences.zh: 以及他们在更广泛系统中拥有的变革工具，对我们的工作绝对是关键的。

sentences.en: Um, and, and really kind of more significant often than children who are often in a very disempowering role and can't affect the changes that will make the difference to them.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且确实比那些经常处于非常无权地位、无法影响能为他们带来改变的儿童更重要。

sentences.en: Um, and also most importantly, I think that every child is unique.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且最重要的是，我认为每个孩子都是独一无二的。

sentences.en: So, um, if you've, you know, if you've seen this before, then to, you know, it's not going to be helpful to go into a situation thinking, you know, and you
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，如果你以前见过这种情况，那么，带着那种想法进入一个新情况是没有帮助的，

sentences.en: understand, you've got to be curious and open to understanding it from their perspective and that it's impacting them very differently to how it might have impacted somebody else.
sentences.zh: 你必须保持好奇心，并从他们的角度去理解，而且这对他们产生的影响可能与对其他人产生的影响截然不同。

sentences.en: And that's not to, um, dismiss the importance of, um, you know, knowing about an area, understanding it, having been
sentences.zh: 这并不是要忽视了解一个领域、理解它、经历过那段旅程的重要性，

sentences.en: through that journey before, but I think that all has to be in the background and you've, the foreground
sentences.zh: 但我认为这一切都必须作为背景，而前景必须是，

sentences.en: has to be, um, that this is a unique, unique child with a unique, unique family with a unique set of circumstances.
sentences.zh: 这是一个独特的孩子，有着独特的家庭和独特的情况。

sentences.en: And your job is to really listen and understand that and fit what you've got to offer with, with, with the strengths of that situation for them.
sentences.zh: 你的工作是真正倾听并理解这一点，并将你所能提供的与他们情况的优势相结合。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I think a really powerful question can be, well, how is that for you?
sentences.zh: 我认为一个非常有力的提问可以是：嗯，这对你来说是什么样的？

sentences.en: Cause then you're getting their unique stance, aren't you?
sentences.zh: 因为这样你就能得到他们独特的立场，不是吗？

sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: Lovely.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: What's, what, what does that involve?
sentences.zh: 那涉及到什么？

sentences.zh: 所以当时面临一个两难境地：我热爱我的工作，但又担心会有新人进来改变我的工作环境。

sentences.en: Uh, and, and that felt like a big step for me.

sentences.en: I was, I think I was, you know, uh, can't remember.
sentences.zh: 我想我当时，你知道，呃，记不清了。

sentences.zh: 我当时大概33岁，怀着我的第一个孩子。

sentences.en: You know, it was the most rubbish time for thinking, um, that I might go into that, uh, leadership role.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那绝对不是考虑进入领导岗位的最佳时机。

sentences.en: Uh, but a colleague of mine was having exactly the same dilemma, uh, and was in a similar state of, uh, stage of life.
sentences.zh: 不过，我的一位同事也面临着同样的困境，而且处于类似的人生阶段。

sentences.en: Um, so I think it was, it was a really gentle step, uh, into what is a huge, can be a huge leap and to, to be able to do that together with somebody and to, um,

sentences.en: you know, when
sentences.zh: 你知道，当

sentences.en: We're going to break it down.
sentences.zh: 我们会把它拆解开来。

sentences.en: And this is the next thing that we're going to do.
sentences.zh: 这是我们接下来要做的。

sentences.en: And for you to do exactly that for them, I think really helped us in the early days.
sentences.zh: 而你也能为他们做同样的事，我认为这在早期真的帮了我们很多。

sentences.en: Um, and I think that the job sharing thing was so important also in giving us confidence, courage, um, bravery, you know, when,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为工作分担模式也非常重要，它给了我们信心、勇气和胆量，你知道，当……

sentences.en: when things were getting tougher, uh, cause the health service has been through all sorts of journeys along that, um, along the way.
sentences.zh: 当事情变得棘手时，因为卫生服务部门在这一路上经历过各种各样的波折。

sentences.en: Um, so yeah, I think, I think I was fortunate that that
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我想我很幸运，那个

sentences.en: timing coincided with someone who I felt I could do the job with.
sentences.zh: 时机恰好遇到了一个我觉得可以一起共事的人。

sentences.en: Um, and that really helped what can be quite a big transition.
sentences.zh: 这真的帮助我们度过了可能相当大的转型期。

sentences.en: I don't know if that answers your question.
sentences.zh: 不知道这是否回答了你的问题。

sentences.en: It does.
sentences.zh: 回答了。

sentences.en: It does.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.zh: 想到在过去的20年里，能与同事培养出如此深厚的友谊，真是一种荣幸和快乐。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: It's, it's, it's brilliant.
sentences.zh: 这真是太棒了。

sentences.en: And, you know, there's huge sadnesses that that's come to an end, but it's the sort of relationship where we're just delighted.

sentences.en: That's the only nature of our relationship now.

sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Level of your relationship.
sentences.zh: 你们关系的升级。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: So that's brilliant.
sentences.zh: 那太棒了。

sentences.en: But I, you know, I think, um, in fact, it was really interesting at our, at my retirement do, um, uh, our heads of service for psychology, also job share.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，事实上，在我的退休聚会上发生了一件很有趣的事，我们的心理学服务主管们也采用了工作分担制。

sentences.en: And apparently we were the inspiration for, for, for, for their relationship to, to take it that, uh, you know, to, to pursue that particular way of working.
sentences.zh: 显然，我们是他们选择这种工作方式的灵感来源。

sentences.en: Um, and I think it's just such a useful model, uh, for all sorts of reasons.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一种非常有用的模式，原因有很多。

sentences.en: Um, particularly if you have children and you prefer to work part time, it, it means that when you're not in work, somebody else is.
sentences.zh: 特别是如果你有孩子，更愿意兼职工作，这意味着当你不在岗时，有别人在。

sentences.en: And I think that allows work to be more in its place, which is a huge privilege actually in a job like ours, which can feel all consuming at times.
sentences.zh: 我认为这让工作能保持在它应有的位置，在像我们这样的工作中，这其实是一种巨大的特权，因为这种工作有时会让人感到精疲力竭。

sentences.en: Hmm.

sentences.zh: 在那期间我休过一次职业假，并且得到了支持，既得到了单位的支持，也得到了我的工作

sentences.en: Um, so it just gives that little bit of flexibility.
sentences.zh: 所以这提供了一点灵活性。

sentences.zh: 2014年，我去了加拿大两年半。

sentences.en: And I, and I think, you know, for me that gave me a completely different experience and meant I came back into the role fresher with new ideas and with new energy.
sentences.zh: 我认为这给了我一种完全不同的体验，意味着我回到岗位时更加耳目一新，有了新的想法和活力。

sentences.en: So I think it really served a useful function at all sorts of levels.

sentences.en: And I think even my work visa meant I couldn't work in health and education because there's no gaps, um, that needed to be filled there in, in Canada.
sentences.zh: 而且我想我的工作签证意味着我不能在医疗和教育领域工作，因为加拿大在这些方面没有空缺。

sentences.en: So I took it as permission not to work.
sentences.zh: 所以我把它当作一个不工作的许可。

sentences.en: Um, but I, and I kept ourselves very busy with, you know, making the most of that opportunity.
sentences.zh: 但我让自己过得很充实，充分利用了那个机会。

sentences.en: And I had young school aged children, which obviously took a bit of sorting out as well, but I did volunteer and I volunteered for Roots of Empathy, which is a
sentences.zh: 当时我有年幼的孩子在上学，这显然也需要处理，但我确实做了志愿者，我为“共情之根”项目做了志愿者，这是一个

sentences.en: And it's something that I've been passionate about bringing over, um, here to the UK and it's now in, in, in, in the region where I worked.
sentences.zh: 我一直热衷于把它引入英国，现在它已经在我的工作区域开展了。

sentences.en: Um, and it, you know, it's just a great program on all sorts of levels, but again, it really fits with what I think is important for children to experience.
sentences.zh: 这是一个在各个层面上都很棒的项目，再次强调，它非常符合我认为对孩子成长很重要的东西。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's, it's brilliant.

sentences.en: neurodevelopmental aspects of child development.
